exact: oxidized pyrimidine base lesion DNA N-glycosylase activity
related: pyrimidine-specific oxidized base lesion DNA N-glycosylase activity

definition: Catalysis of the removal oxidized pyrimidine bases by cleaving the N-C1' glycosidic bond between the oxidized pyrimidine and the deoxyribose sugar. The reaction involves formation of a covalent enzyme-pyrimidine base intermediate. Release of the enzyme and free base by a beta-elimination or a beta, gamma-elimination mechanism results in the cleavage of the DNA backbone 3' of the apyrimidinic (AP) site.
label: Cleavage of dihydrouracil by NTHL1 glycosylase
